svg.title: Lap time on matched starts
svg.desc: Percentage change in lap time on starts finished by all three controllers.. 0% = equal time. Negative values favour nose guard.. Against previous arc. Mean −9.91% · median −9.06% · 86/86 faster. Oschersleben · seed 73404 −64.53%. Against edited PPO. Mean −1.73% · median −1.50% · 62/86 faster
